NEW EVENTS - LIVING CULTURE VI: LAVASTONES AND THE SCHOOLS OF THOUGHT (LCF-01..50, draft, 2026-11-18)
Lavastones, the glowing orange-pink stones of Isola's lore, found on beaches and falling from the sky, and what they cost; and the island's schools of thought, Nature, Science, Spiritualism and Magic, arguing with and borrowing from each other.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. The owner waived the review ("I'm sure the draft events are fine"); every event passed the Isola rules and the final 15-point review, logged in the notes.

collection.description: The village argues whether lavastones are a gift or a curse: ban them, or keep them with care.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: After a villager was badly dazed by a lavastone last month, (subject) wants the village to ban them: bury every one found, and never use them. (friend) says the same stones saved two lives last year. The gathering is divided. What should the village decide?

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: The village decides to bury every lavastone found. For a season, there are no accidents. Then a child falls very ill, and the healers have nothing strong enough. The ban is quietly lifted for the healers. (subject) understands.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: The village keeps its stones, but makes rules: only trained hands, only in great need, never alone. (subject) helps write the rules. The stones stay locked in the elders' hut, glowing.
